falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below its 50-day moving average for 5 consecutive trading sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current HOLD signal and 74% pattern match to mini_top_2019_jun assumes a consolidation phase with underlying support. A sustained break below the 50-day MA would indicate distribution rather than accumulation, invalidating the top-formation thesis and suggesting a deeper correction is underway.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 56 and HOLD verdict assume volatility remains contained. A VIX spike above 25 would signal panic selling or a risk-off event, which contradicts the gradual top-building pattern and would indicate the market is breaking down faster than the mini_top_2019_jun analog suggests.

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 fails to make a new high within the same 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current verdict assumes risk appetite is intact enough to sustain a topping process. A sharp flight to safety in bonds without a corresponding equity high would show that the macro engine's HOLD signal is misreading the rotation—money is leaving equities for safety, not rotating within risk assets, which invalidates the blowoff continuation scenario.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
